questions.stem: A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 36,410 \) is to be repaid in \( 3 \) equal annual installments at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum. Find the value of each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Let each installment be \( x \). Present value of all installments = Principal
\( \frac{x}{1.1} + \frac{x}{(1.1)^2} + \frac{x}{(1.1)^3} = 36410 \)
\( x \left( 0.9091 + 0.8264 + 0.7513 \right) = 36410 \)
\( x \times 2.4868 = 36410 \)
\( x = \frac{36410}{2.4868} = 14641 \)

questions.stem: Rahul takes a loan of \( \text{Rs. } 1,50,000 \) at \( 20\% \) compound interest per annum and agrees to pay in \( 3 \) equal annual installments. What is the amount of each installment?
A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 5,880 \) and agrees to repay in \( 2 \) equal annual installments at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum. Find each installment amount.
A loan is to be paid back in \( 2 \) equal annual installments of \( \text{Rs. } 2,523 \) each at \( 16\% \) compound interest per annum. Find the principal amount.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 8,000 \) at \( 15\% \) compound interest per annum. He repays \( \text{Rs. } 3,000 \) at the end of first year and \( \text{Rs. } 4,000 \) at the end of second year. What amount should he pay at the end of third year to clear all dues?
questions.keySolution:
Amount after 1st year = \( 8000 \times 1.15 = 9200 \)
After paying \( 3000 \), balance = \( 9200 - 3000 = 6200 \)
Amount after 2nd year = \( 6200 \times 1.15 = 7130 \)
After paying \( 4000 \), balance = \( 7130 - 4000 = 3130 \)
Amount after 3rd year = \( 3130 \times 1.15 = 3599.50 \)

questions.stem: A sum of money is borrowed at \( 12\% \) compound interest per annum and is repaid in \( 3 \) equal annual installments of \( \text{Rs. } 4,000 \) each. Find the sum borrowed.

A person takes a loan and agrees to pay \( \text{Rs. } 1,000 \) at the end of first year, \( \text{Rs. } 2,000 \) at the end of second year, and \( \text{Rs. } 3,000 \) at the end of third year at \( 8\% \) compound interest per annum. Find the loan amount.
A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 10,000 \) at \( 18\% \) compound interest per annum is to be repaid in \( 2 \) equal half-yearly installments. Find each installment.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 5,000 \) at \( 16\% \) compound interest per annum. He pays \( \text{Rs. } 500 \) at the end of first year. What amount should he pay at the end of second year to clear all dues?
questions.keySolution:
Amount after 1st year = \( 5000 \times 1.16 = 5800 \)
After paying \( 500 \), balance = \( 5800 - 500 = 5300 \)
Amount after 2nd year = \( 5300 \times 1.16 = 6148 \)

questions.stem: A computer costs \( \text{Rs. } 75,300 \) cash or \( \text{Rs. } 25,000 \) down payment and \( 2 \) half-yearly installments of \( \text{Rs. } 28,000 \) each at \( 20\% \) compound interest per annum. Which option is better for the buyer?
questions.keySolution:
Half-yearly rate = \( \frac{20}{2} = 10\% \)
Present value of installment scheme = \( 25000 + \frac{28000}{1.1} + \frac{28000}{1.21} \)
\( = 25000 + 25454.55 + 23140.50 = 73595.05 \)
Difference = \( 75300 - 73595.05 = 1704.95 \approx 1705 \)
Cash payment is better by \( \text{Rs. } 1705 \)

questions.stem: A person takes a loan of \( \text{Rs. } 20,000 \) at \( 25\% \) compound interest per annum to be repaid in \( 2 \) equal annual installments. Find the value of each installment.
A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 9,960 \) is borrowed at \( 7.5\% \) compound interest per annum and repaid in \( 2 \) equal annual installments. Find each installment.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 15,000 \) at \( 24\% \) compound interest per annum compounded every \( 5 \) months. If the amount becomes \( \text{Rs. } 19,965 \) after \( 15 \) months, verify the calculation.
questions.keySolution:
Time periods = \( \frac{15}{5} = 3 \) periods
Rate per period = \( \frac{24 \times 5}{12} = 10\% \)
Amount = \( 15000 \times (1.1)^3 = 15000 \times 1.331 = 19965 \)
The calculation matches exactly, confirming the rate is \( 24\% \) per annum

questions.stem: A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 12,000 \) at \( 15\% \) compound interest per annum is to be cleared by \( 3 \) annual installments in arithmetic progression. If the first installment is \( \text{Rs. } 3,000 \), find the common difference.

A person takes a loan at \( 12\% \) compound interest per annum and agrees to pay \( \text{Rs. } 5,000 \) after \( 1 \) year and \( \text{Rs. } 6,000 \) after \( 2 \) years to clear the loan. Find the loan amount.

A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 8,000 \) at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum is repaid by \( 3 \) installments of \( \text{Rs. } 2,000, \text{Rs. } 3,000 \), and \( \text{Rs. } X \) at the end of \( 1st, 2nd \), and \( 3rd \) years respectively. Find \( X \).
A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 6,000 \) is lent at \( 20\% \) compound interest per annum and is recovered in \( 3 \) equal annual installments. Find the total interest paid.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 25,000 \) at \( 8\% \) compound interest per annum. He repays \( \text{Rs. } 10,000 \) at the end of first year and \( \text{Rs. } 12,000 \) at the end of second year. What is the outstanding amount at the end of third year?
questions.keySolution:
After 1st year: \( 25000 \times 1.08 = 27000 \)
Balance after payment: \( 27000 - 10000 = 17000 \)
After 2nd year: \( 17000 \times 1.08 = 18360 \)
Balance after payment: \( 18360 - 12000 = 6360 \)
After 3rd year: \( 6360 \times 1.08 = 6868.80 \approx 6869 \)

questions.stem: A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 18,000 \) at \( 15\% \) compound interest per annum is to be repaid in \( 4 \) equal quarterly installments. Find each installment amount.
questions.keySolution:
Quarterly rate = \( \frac{15}{4} = 3.75\% \)
Let each installment be \( x \)
\( \sum_{n=1}^{4} \frac{x}{(1.0375)^n} = 18000 \)
Using present value factor for \( 4 \) quarters at \( 3.75\% \): \( 3.5473 \)
\( x = \frac{18000}{3.5473} = 5076 \)

questions.stem: A person takes a loan of \( \text{Rs. } 50,000 \) at \( 12\% \) compound interest per annum. If he wants to repay it in \( 5 \) equal annual installments, what should be the amount of each installment?
questions.keySolution:
Let each installment be \( x \)
Using present value annuity formula: \( P = x \times \frac{1-(1+r)^{-n}}{r} \)
\( 50000 = x \times \frac{1-(1.12)^{-5}}{0.12} \)
\( 50000 = x \times 3.6048 \)
\( x = \frac{50000}{3.6048} = 13870 \)

questions.stem: A machine worth \( \text{Rs. } 60,000 \) can be purchased by paying \( \text{Rs. } 15,000 \) down and balance in \( 3 \) equal annual installments at \( 10\% \) compound interest. Find each installment.
A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 7,260 \) is borrowed at \( 12.5\% \) compound interest per annum and repaid in \( 2 \) equal annual installments. Find each installment.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 40,000 \) at \( 18\% \) compound interest per annum. He pays \( \text{Rs. } 20,000 \) after \( 1 \) year. After how much time should he pay \( \text{Rs. } 30,000 \) to clear the debt?

A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 30,000 \) at \( 14\% \) compound interest per annum is to be repaid in \( 3 \) installments such that the first installment is twice the second, and the second installment is twice the third. Find the third installment.

A person takes a loan at \( 16\% \) compound interest per annum and agrees to pay \( \text{Rs. } 6,000 \) at the end of first year and \( \text{Rs. } 8,000 \) at the end of second year. If the original loan was \( \text{Rs. } 15,000 \), what amount should he pay at the end of third year?
questions.keySolution:
Amount after 3 years = \( 15000 \times (1.16)^3 = 23413.50 \)
Value of 1st payment at end of 3rd year = \( 6000 \times (1.16)^2 = 8073.60 \)
Value of 2nd payment at end of 3rd year = \( 8000 \times 1.16 = 9280 \)
Remaining amount = \( 23413.50 - 8073.60 - 9280 = 6059.90 \approx 6060 \)

questions.stem: A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 22,000 \) is borrowed at \( 11\% \) compound interest per annum and is to be repaid in \( 4 \) equal annual installments. Find the amount of each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Using present value of annuity formula:
\( 22000 = x \times \frac{1-(1.11)^{-4}}{0.11} \)
\( 22000 = x \times 3.1024 \)
\( x = \frac{22000}{3.1024} = 7089 \)

questions.stem: A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 16,000 \) at \( 13\% \) compound interest per annum is repaid by paying \( \text{Rs. } 5,000 \) at the end of first year, \( \text{Rs. } 6,000 \) at the end of second year. What amount should be paid at the end of third year?
A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 35,000 \) at \( 9\% \) compound interest per annum to be repaid in \( 5 \) equal annual installments. What is the total amount paid over the \( 5 \) years?
questions.keySolution:
Each installment = \( \frac{35000}{3.8897} = 9035 \)
Total amount paid = \( 5 \times 9035 = 45175 \)
Using annuity factor for \( 9\% \) over \( 5 \) years = \( 3.8897 \)

questions.stem: A car costing \( \text{Rs. } 80,000 \) can be bought by paying \( \text{Rs. } 20,000 \) down and the balance in \( 4 \) equal half-yearly installments at \( 16\% \) compound interest per annum. Find each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Balance = \( 80000 - 20000 = 60000 \)
Half-yearly rate = \( \frac{16}{2} = 8\% \)
Using annuity formula for \( 4 \) periods at \( 8\% \): factor = \( 3.3121 \)
\( x = \frac{60000}{3.3121} = 18113 \)

questions.stem: A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 12,100 \) is borrowed at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum and repaid in \( 2 \) equal annual installments. What is the total interest paid?
questions.keySolution:
Each installment = \( \frac{12100}{1.7355} = 6970 \)
Total payment = \( 2 \times 6970 = 13940 \)
Total interest = \( 13940 - 12100 = 1840 \)
Using factor \( 1.7355 \) for \( 10\% \) over \( 2 \) years

questions.stem: A person takes a loan of \( \text{Rs. } 45,000 \) at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum. He repays it in \( 3 \) annual installments in arithmetic progression. If the first installment is \( \text{Rs. } 12,000 \), find the last installment.
A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 24,000 \) at \( 12.5\% \) compound interest per annum is to be cleared in \( 2 \) years by paying equal installments at the end of each year. Find each installment.

A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 18,500 \) at \( 15\% \) compound interest per annum. He wants to clear this loan by paying \( \text{Rs. } 8,000 \) at the end of first year and the balance at the end of second year. Find the second payment.
A sum of money is borrowed at \( 20\% \) compound interest per annum and is repaid in \( 3 \) equal annual installments of \( \text{Rs. } 9,260 \) each. Find the sum borrowed.

A person takes a loan at \( 8\% \) compound interest per annum and repays it by paying \( \text{Rs. } 2,500 \) at the end of first year, \( \text{Rs. } 3,000 \) at the end of second year, and \( \text{Rs. } 3,500 \) at the end of third year. Find the loan amount.
A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 28,000 \) at \( 15\% \) compound interest per annum is repaid in \( 4 \) equal annual installments. What is the difference between the total amount paid and the principal?
questions.keySolution:
Each installment = \( \frac{28000}{2.855} = 9807 \)
Total payment = \( 4 \times 9807 = 39228 \)
Total interest = \( 39228 - 28000 = 11228 \)
Using annuity factor \( 2.855 \) for \( 15\% \) over \( 4 \) years

questions.stem: A person borrows \( \text{Rs. } 32,000 \) at \( 12\% \) compound interest per annum. If the loan is to be repaid in \( 3 \) equal annual installments, find the present value of the second installment.
questions.keySolution:
Each installment = \( \frac{32000}{2.402} = 13322 \)
Present value of 2nd installment = \( \frac{13322}{(1.12)^2} = \frac{13322}{1.2544} = 10621 \)
Using annuity factor \( 2.402 \) for \( 12\% \) over \( 3 \) years

questions.stem: A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 15,000 \) is borrowed at \( 18\% \) compound interest per annum. The borrower agrees to repay the principal with interest in \( 2 \) installments such that the second installment is \( 50\% \) more than the first. Find the first installment.

A person takes a loan of \( \text{Rs. } 50,000 \) at \( 16\% \) compound interest per annum. He repays \( \text{Rs. } 15,000 \) at the end of first year, \( \text{Rs. } 20,000 \) at the end of second year, and wants to clear the remaining debt at the end of third year. Find the final payment.

A loan of \( \text{Rs. } 42,000 \) at \( 14\% \) compound interest per annum is to be repaid in \( 3 \) equal annual installments. What is the ratio of the interest component to the principal component in the first installment?
questions.keySolution:
Each installment = \( \frac{42000}{2.322} = 18090 \)
Interest in 1st year = \( 42000 \times 0.14 = 5880 \)
Principal component = \( 18090 - 5880 = 12210 \)
Ratio = \( 5880:12210 = 12:25 \)
Using factor \( 2.322 \) for \( 14\% \) over \( 3 \) years

questions.stem: A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 26,400 \) is borrowed at \( 10\% \) compound interest per annum and is to be repaid in \( 4 \) annual installments in geometric progression with first installment being \( \text{Rs. } 5,000 \). Find the common ratio.
